limitations: Actual registered handlers/native host documents, regular files, real PNG/ICNS/native thumbnail decoding. Oversized/malformed decoder inputs are dispatch observers, not hostile native decoding. Picker selection, source replacement after initial stat, read/native-thumbnail completion are controlled. No production preload/physical input, all formats/platforms, native decoder sandbox, OS file-icon resource parsing or peak memory/CPU claim.
Snapshot reads are bounded/descriptor-owned with stat checks; this does not exclude every same-size in-place mutation or same-user modification of a private temporary file.

No decoder sandbox, complete animation/container validation, every image format/platform, crash/power-loss temporary cleanup, OS file-icon resource containment, peak CPU/RSS or general latency improvement claim.

5 MiB/2048-side icon and 20 MiB/40MP raster-thumbnail limits; unsupported or oversized download previews use an OS file-type icon. Four active thumbnail pipelines and 128 pending IDs. Temporary copies add I/O; completion latency is not benchmarked.
Full unit suite, lint/types, build and scoped native/preload integration verified; no full desktop suite or signed/cross-platform release claim.
